port.name: Expressive Code
port.description: Living Code for Expressive Code. Repository-owned theme files, installation instructions and four color flavors.

guide.configuration: See [Expressive Code's documentation](https://expressive-code.com) for application settings and reload behavior. The activation instructions above identify each supported flavor; keep your other application configuration.
guide.compatibility: Preserves the npm package name `@living-code/expressive-code` and its existing import paths. Package publication and registry credentials are separate from creating this repository.
